actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Google Translate action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Google Translate connection OAuth scopes: Scopes Translate text from one language to another using Google Translate

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: text_translate
actions.title: Translate text
actions.description: Translate a text to another language
actions.help: This action translates a text from one language to another language.

input.name: target
input.label: Target language
input.hint: Translate the text to this language.

input.name: source
input.label: Source language
input.hint: The language of your provided text. If left blank, Google will automatically detect the language.
